title: Asking Permission to Borrow Something
paragraphs: Working late one evening, Umar realizes he forgot his own charger at home and notices his coworker's charger sitting unused on the next desk, plugged in and free at that moment.
Even though his coworker has already left for the day and would likely not mind, Umar decides to send a quick message asking permission first, rather than simply taking it without saying anything.
His coworker replies within a minute, giving cheerful permission and adding that he was welcome to use it anytime he needed to charge his phone during a busy workday.
Umar plugs in his phone, feeling that the small delay of asking first was worth the peace of mind it gave him, compared to simply assuming permission that had not actually been given yet.
